name: Asylum / Refugee Status

requirements.blocker_text: The State Migration Service (SMS) of the Republic of Azerbaijan -- not UNHCR -- examines asylum applications individually against criteria set by international conventions and domestic law. The applicant must be within Azerbaijani territory or at a port of entry to apply.

evidence_required.document: Asylum application filed with the State Migration Service

sources.title: UNHCR Azerbaijan -- confirms Azerbaijan's own State Migration Service (not UNHCR) examines asylum applications against international-convention and domestic-law criteria; application requires presence in Azerbaijani territory or at a port of entry; the page references status-determination and appeal phases without further procedural detail

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Azerbaijan).
